facts.fact: According to Wyzowl's 2025 report, 89% of businesses use video for marketing.
facts.quote: According to [Wyzowl's 2025 report](https://wyzowl.com/video-marketing-statistics/), 89% of businesses use video for marketing

facts.fact: According to Wyzowl's 2025 report, 93% of marketers say video delivers a good return on investment.
facts.quote: 93% of marketers say it delivers a good return on investment.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's free plan includes 75 credits, which the vendor says is enough for a first video.
facts.quote: The free plan gives you 75 credits (enough for your first video), 480p exports, and a watermark.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's paid plans remove the watermark, and its Business plan unlocks exports up to 4K.
facts.quote: Paid plans remove the watermark and unlock higher resolution, up to 4K on Business.

facts.fact: According to Wavemaker, a 30-second video costs about 75 credits to generate.
facts.quote: A 30-second video runs about 75 credits; a 60-second video runs about 150.

facts.fact: Wavemaker says most videos are ready in 2 to 5 minutes.
facts.quote: Most videos are ready in 2 to 5 minutes.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's pipeline builds an AI storyboard from 21 presets.
facts.quote: builds an AI storyboard from 21 presets

facts.fact: The guide recommends a TikTok ad run 9 to 15 seconds, with a maximum of 34 seconds, in 9:16 vertical format.
facts.quote: | TikTok | 9-15 sec (up to 34 sec) | 9:16 vertical | Hook in first 1-2 sec; sound-on culture |

facts.fact: The guide recommends a YouTube bumper ad be 6 seconds long and non-skippable, in 16:9 format.
facts.quote: | YouTube bumper | 6 sec (non-skippable) | 16:9 | One message, one visual, one CTA |

facts.fact: The guide recommends a streaming TV (CTV) ad run 30 seconds in 16:9 format, non-skippable.
facts.quote: | Streaming TV / CTV | 30 sec | 16:9 | Non-skippable; broadcast pacing; URL or QR for CTA |

facts.fact: The guide recommends Facebook and Instagram feed video ads run 15 to 30 seconds in 1:1 or 4:5 aspect ratio.
facts.quote: | Facebook / Instagram feed | 15-30 sec | 1:1 or 4:5 | Assume sound off; front-load message |

facts.fact: The guide recommends a YouTube skippable in-stream ad run 15 to 30 seconds in 16:9 format, with the first 5 seconds needing to earn the skip.
facts.quote: | YouTube skippable in-stream | 15-30 sec | 16:9 | First 5 sec must earn the skip |

facts.fact: The guide recommends an ad's hook land within the first 3 seconds, before a viewer scrolls past or skips.
facts.quote: You have about three seconds before someone scrolls past or reaches for the skip button.

facts.fact: The guide recommends a website or landing page video run 30 to 60 seconds in 16:9 format.
facts.quote: | Website / landing page | 30-60 sec | 16:9 | More room to explain; still lead with the hook |

facts.fact: Adwave can place a finished Wavemaker video on 100+ premium streaming networks starting from $50, according to the page.
facts.quote: can put it in front of viewers on 100+ premium streaming networks, starting from $50

facts.fact: The page's workflow section says Adwave can put a video on streaming TV from $30 a day, which conflicts with the $50 starting price stated earlier on the page.
facts.quote: use Adwave to put it on streaming TV from $30 a day

facts.fact: The page's FAQ says running a finished Wavemaker ad on streaming TV through Adwave starts at $30 a day.
facts.quote: Running the finished ad on streaming TV through Adwave starts at $30 a day.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's free plan includes 75 credits, which the page says is enough for one video, with a 480p watermarked export.
facts.quote: 75 credits, enough for one video, with a 480p watermarked export

facts.fact: Wavemaker paid plans start at $29 per month for higher resolution and no watermark.
facts.quote: Paid plans start at $29/mo for higher resolution and no watermark.

facts.fact: The page says traditional TV advertising used to require five-figure production budgets and agency retainers.
facts.quote: TV advertising used to mean five-figure production budgets and agency retainers.

facts.fact: The page recommends video ads for social feeds and YouTube Shorts run 9 to 15 seconds.
facts.quote: Social feeds and Shorts do best at 9 to 15 seconds

facts.fact: The page recommends YouTube skippable video ads run 15 to 30 seconds.
facts.quote: YouTube skippable ads at 15 to 30 seconds

facts.fact: The page states streaming TV commercials run 30 seconds.
facts.quote: streaming TV commercials run 30 seconds

facts.fact: The page suggests a 30-to-60-second explainer works well on your own channels such as landing pages, email, and organic social.
facts.quote: a great place for a longer 30-to-60-second explainer

facts.fact: The page recommends exporting a 16:9 version for YouTube and TV and a 9:16 version for social.
facts.quote: A 16:9 version for YouTube and TV, a 9:16 for social.
